name: openmunicipality-conprel
title: Spanish municipal budgets (CONPREL), normalised for OpenMunicipality
description: Consolidated budgets 2010-2025 and outturns 2010-2024 of Spanish municipalities from the Ministry of Finance CONPREL database, grouped into plain-language areas. Outturns use recognised obligations (spending) and recognised rights (income). Built with scripts/build_conprel.py. Before 2014, programme detail is missing for municipalities that were allowed to report only by area and policy.

licenses.name: ES-public-sector-reuse
licenses.title: Public-sector information reusable with attribution under Ley 37/2007 (Spain): cite Ministerio de Hacienda (CONPREL) and INE. The municipal code list comes from Code for Spain under ODC-PDDL.

sources.title: INE municipal codes via Code for Spain (ODC-PDDL)
